content.name: Potion of Diminution
entries: When you drink this potion, you gain the "reduce" effect of the {@spell enlarge/reduce} spell for {@dice 1d4} hours (no {@status concentration} required). The red in the potion's liquid continuously contracts to a tiny bead and then expands to color the clear liquid around it. Shaking the bottle fails to interrupt this process.
